name: Magna Unio of the Augustinian Hermits
summary: Alexander IV's Licet Ecclesiae catholicae regimini consolidates the Tuscan Hermits, Williamites, Bonites, and other eremitic communities into a single Order of Hermits of Saint Augustine with a centralised priory at Santa Maria del Popolo in Rome.

_quarry.structural_significance: Final addition to the classical four mendicant orders; centuries later furnishes Martin Luther's monastic formation.
